groups.label: Research
groups.description: Research software, modelling tools, papers and formal statistical work.

groups.label: Apps
groups.description: Apps, tools, readers and games for health, family life, research and play.

groups.label: Blogs
groups.description: Public-interest analysis of health, access, services and everyday policy questions.

projects.title: Little Now
projects.description: Caregiver-led play for ages 1–5: one practical activity matched to the time, setup and interests available right now.

details.Built for: Caregivers who want a useful idea quickly, then want to put the phone away.
details.Current focus: Preparing the first App Store release and its public activity-sharing flow.

projects.title: In Another Life
projects.description: A small daily ritual for two: share the same animal-pair photo on both of your Home Screen widgets.

details.Built for: Two people who want a quiet moment of connection each day.
details.Current focus: Private beta testing, paired widgets and preparing the first public release.

projects.title: Starfall
projects.description: A touch-first science-fantasy tactics game about positioning, pressure and keeping a small company alive.

details.Current state: The core loop is playable as a local MVP.
details.Current focus: Combat feel, encounter pacing and a coherent route to a public build.

projects.title: Faintburn
projects.description: A single-player space-career RPG for iOS: fly between regions, take contracts and find your own way through a living frontier.

details.Built for: Players who enjoy exploration, career progression and a persistent space adventure.
details.Current focus: Flight feel, a living world and testing the experience on iPhone.

projects.title: Panels
projects.description: A private reading workspace for organising, opening and working through visual publications.

details.Access: The deployment is active but intentionally limited to approved accounts.

projects.title: Household Budget
projects.description: A small, private household budgeting tool for keeping shared cash, spending and reconciliation clear.

details.Availability: Internal tool; financial details and the deployment remain private.

projects.title: gamlss.longitudinal
projects.description: Tools for fitting longitudinal GAMLSS models with flexible margins and copula dependence.

details.Built for: Repeated-measures problems where changing scale, skewness, tails, quantiles or within-subject dependence matter.
details.Current focus: Documentation, examples and practical modelling workflows.

projects.title: Distribution Playground
projects.description: Interactive GAMLSS distributions, copula dependence, quantile comparison and longitudinal simulation in one R-backed workbench.

details.Built for: Researchers, students and collaborators who need distribution shape and dependence to be visible.
details.Current focus: Deepening worked examples, interpretation and export workflows.

projects.title: Copula-based joint regression models for correlated data
projects.description: A bivariate comparison of copula-based, mixed-model and estimating-equation approaches for correlated regression.

details.Question: What can the different correlated-data strategies represent, and where do their trade-offs show up?
details.Availability: The preprint and reproducible code are public.

projects.title: Longitudinal GAMLSS Models With Copula Dependence in R
projects.description: A paper describing longitudinal GAMLSS models with flexible margins and first-order copula dependence in R.

details.Current focus: Developing the manuscript, package examples, validation and reproducible reviewer materials.

projects.title: Did Bulk Billing Changes Shift Access?
projects.description: An early look at whether expanded GP bulk-billing incentives changed access patterns.

details.Current focus: Policy signal, timing artefacts and reporting noise.

projects.title: A First Pass At Australian Dwelling Prices
projects.description: A reproducible look at ABS dwelling values, state mean prices and the policy questions they raise.

details.Current focus: Housing, cost of living and public data.

projects.title: Are NDIS Participant Outcomes Changing?
projects.description: A simpler look at national participant outcome levels and changes after plan reassessment.

details.Current focus: Descriptive movement kept separate from causal interpretation.
